description: Unique ID of the nightly record (S00001-S05000).
Anonymous participant ID (P001-P100). No names or personal identifiers are stored.
Calendar date on which the night started (YYYY-MM-DD).
Day name of the night's start date.
1 for Friday and Saturday nights, otherwise 0.
Participant age in years (18-65).
Participant gender (Male/Female).
Body-mass index (kg/m^2).
Clock time the participant went to bed (HH:MM, 24-hour).
Clock time the participant got out of bed (HH:MM, 24-hour).
Hours from bedtime to wake time = total sleep + latency + WASO.
Minutes taken to fall asleep after going to bed.
Total hours actually asleep.
Total sleep / time in bed x 100.
Number of awakenings after falling asleep.
Wake After Sleep Onset: minutes awake after first falling asleep.
Share of total sleep spent in deep (N3) sleep.
Share of total sleep spent in REM sleep.
Share of total sleep spent in light (N1/N2) sleep; deep + REM + light = 100.
Average heart rate during sleep (beats per minute).
Lowest blood-oxygen saturation recorded during the night (%).
Breathing disturbances per hour of sleep (apnea-hypopnea style index).
Caffeine consumed during the day (mg).
Screen use in the two hours before bed (minutes).
Steps walked during the day.
Self-reported stress for the day (1 = low, 10 = high).
Ground-truth sleep pattern: normal, insomnia, sleep_deprivation, irregular_schedule, apnea_risk or oversleeping.
1 if abnormality_type is not 'normal', otherwise 0.
